steps.label: Introduce RAM installation and prepare motherboard
Identify DIMM slots and RAM module
Align RAM notch with DIMM slot
Position RAM module over DIMM slot
Press RAM module into DIMM slot
Verify RAM module is seated and locked

annotation_method: Boundary times supplied by the author; reviewed against 0.15 s contact sheets during integration (installintelcpu 3.70 s and 23.20 s verified to land on the frame where the action changes).
